mapper.sql: select id, contract_no, contract_name, client_unit, contact_name, contact_phone, contract_type, contract_amount, sign_date, entrust_date, audit_date, return_date, finish_date, archive_date, archive_path, contract_period, payment_terms, received_amount, status, is_settled, extra_data::text as extra_data, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from proj_contract
mapper.select: select cp.id as price_id, cp.contract_id, cp.category_id, cp.price, c.name as category_name, pc.name as parent_name from proj_contract_price cp inner join proj_category c on c.id = cp.category_id and c.del_flag = '0' left join proj_category pc on pc.id = c.parent_id and pc.del_flag = '0' where cp.contract_id = #{contractId} and cp.del_flag = '0' order by c.parent_id, c.sort_order
mapper.insert: insert into proj_contract( contract_no, contract_name, client_unit, contact_name, contact_phone, contract_type, contract_amount, sign_date, entrust_date, audit_date, return_date, finish_date, archive_date, archive_path, contract_period, payment_terms, received_amount, status, is_settled, extra_data, remark, create_by, create_time )values( #{contractNo}, #{contractName}, #{clientUnit}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{contractType}, #{contractAmount}, #{signDate}, #{entrustDate}, #{auditDate}, #{returnDate}, #{finishDate}, #{archiveDate}, #{archivePath}, #{contractPeriod}, #{paymentTerms}, #{receivedAmount}, #{status}, #{isSettled}, #{extraData}::jsonb, #{remark}, #{createBy}, now() )
mapper.delete: update proj_contract set del_flag = '2' where id = #{id}

mapper.update: update proj_contract set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, contract_no, contract_name, entrust_date from proj_contract where del_flag = '0' and entrust_date is not null and entrust_date < now() - interval '7 days' and finish_date is null order by entrust_date asc
